product: High Strength Deformed (TMT / HYSD) Steel Rebar

allied_standards.title: Method for Tensile testing of Steel products  – 1972
allied_standards.note: Mandatory tensile testing method prescribed in Clause 8.1 of IS 1786:2008 for determining 0.2% proof stress / yield strength, tensile strength (UTS), and percentage elongation of deformed rebar.

allied_standards.title: Metallic Materials — Bend Test
allied_standards.note: Mandatory ductility verification method prescribed in Clause 8.3 & 9.3 of IS 1786:2008 for performing bend and rebend tests around specified mandrel diameters without fracture.

allied_standards.title: Methods for Chemical Analysis of Steels (Relevant Parts)
allied_standards.note: Mandatory chemical analysis procedures prescribed in Clause 4.2 of IS 1786:2008 for determining percentages of Carbon, Sulphur, Phosphorus, and Carbon Equivalent (CE).

allied_standards.title: Code of practice for bending & fixing of bars for concrete reinforcement
allied_standards.note: Governing site workmanship standard for cutting, bending schedules, minimum internal bend radii, hooks, laps, and tying of TMT bars in RCC members.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practices for plain and reinforced concrete etc.  – 2000
allied_standards.note: The central Indian RCC code specifying design yield strength, modular ratio, characteristic strength, development length, and concrete cover for IS 1786 rebar.

allied_standards.title: Methods of physical test for hydraulic cement
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing protocol prescribed in Clause 6, 7, and 8 of IS 269:2015 for evaluating cement fineness (Part 1/2), soundness (Part 3), setting times (Part 5), and compressive strength (Part 6).

allied_standards.title: Method of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement
allied_standards.note: Mandatory chemical testing protocol prescribed in Clause 5 of IS 269:2015 for determining loss on ignition, insoluble residue, magnesia content, and lime saturation factor.

allied_standards.title: Method of sampling for hydraulic cement
allied_standards.note: Mandatory sampling procedure prescribed in Clause 8 of IS 269:2015 for taking representative lot samples from bulk tankers, silos, and bagged supplies.

allied_standards.title: Standard sand testing of cement
allied_standards.note: Mandatory reference testing material (Ennore standard sand Grades I, II, III) required to prepare standardized mortar cubes for testing OPC compressive strength under IS 4031 (Part 6).

allied_standards.title: specifications for storage of materials
allied_standards.note: Prescribes protective stacking and warehouse storage practices (raised wooden platforms, maximum 10-tier bag stack, moisture control) to prevent air-setting of cement bags on construction sites.

allied_standards.title: Specification for 33,43,53 Grade ordinary Portland cement
allied_standards.note: Mandatory primary cementitious constituent specified in Clause 5.1 and Annex A of IS 456:2000 for concrete batching.

allied_standards.title: Specification for coarse and fine aggregate
allied_standards.note: Mandatory mineral aggregate specification governing grading, maximum nominal size, and deleterious substance thresholds in structural concrete.

allied_standards.title: Specifications for HYSD bars.  – 1985
allied_standards.note: Primary reinforcement steel specification governing yield stress, characteristic strength, and detailing requirements for reinforced concrete.

allied_standards.title: Specification for compressive strength , flexural strength
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing method for compressive strength testing of concrete cubes (150 mm) at 7 and 28 days to establish characteristic strength fck.

allied_standards.title: Methods of sampling and analysis of concrete  – 1959
allied_standards.note: Mandatory field sampling procedure and fresh concrete workability test (slump test, compacting factor) required on site before placing.

allied_standards.title: specifications for concrete admixtures
allied_standards.note: Governing specification for chemical admixtures (accelerators, retarders, water reducers, superplasticizers) added to concrete mixes.

allied_standards.title: Recommended Guide Lines for Concrete Mix Design  – 1982
allied_standards.note: Authoritative engineering procedure for calculating water-cement ratio, cementitious contents, and aggregate fractions to produce design mix concrete.

allied_standards.title: specifications for plywood formwork for concrete
allied_standards.note: Material and surface tolerance standard governing shuttering plywood used to contain and support wet concrete during curing.

product: Coarse and Fine Aggregates for Concrete

allied_standards.title: Methods of test for aggregate for concrete particle size and shape
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing method for particle size distribution (sieve analysis), fineness modulus, flakiness index, and elongation index of aggregates.

allied_standards.title: Methods of test for aggregate for concrete estimation of deleterious materials and organic impurities
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing method to quantify deleterious materials including clay lumps, fine silt/dust, and organic impurities in fine and coarse aggregates.

allied_standards.title: Methods of test for aggregate for concrete: Specific gravity, density, voids, absorption and bulking
allied_standards.note: Mandatory test method for specific gravity, bulk density, water absorption (capped at 2% for structural aggregate), and bulking of fine aggregate.

allied_standards.title: Methods of test for aggregate for Mechanical properties
allied_standards.note: Mandatory mechanical test methods for Aggregate Crushing Value (ACV), Aggregate Impact Value (AIV), and Los Angeles Abrasion value.

allied_standards.title: Methods of test for aggregate Soundness
allied_standards.note: Mandatory chemical soundness test subjecting aggregates to alternate immersion cycles in sodium or magnesium sulphate solutions to verify resistance to weathering.

allied_standards.title: methods of sampling
allied_standards.note: Prescribes standard sampling methodology for taking representative increments from conveyor belts, stockpiles, trucks, and quarries.

allied_standards.title: Method of test for burnt-clay building bricks
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing procedures prescribed in Clauses 6, 7, and 8 of IS 1077:1992 for compressive strength, water absorption (max 20%), efflorescence, and warpage.

allied_standards.title: Method of sampling of clay building bricks
allied_standards.note: Mandatory sampling procedure prescribed in Clause 9 of IS 1077:1992 for lot inspection, sample sizing, dimensional testing, and compressive test specimen selection.

allied_standards.title: Specification for sand for masonry mortars
allied_standards.note: Essential companion standard specifying grading and purity of sand used to formulate cement-sand and composite mortar for laying IS 1077 bricks in structural walls.

allied_standards.title: Code of practice for preparation and use of masonry mortar
allied_standards.note: Governing workmanship and mixing practice standard for mortar proportioning, batching, joint thickness, and application during brick masonry execution.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice for Brickwork
allied_standards.note: The primary Indian civil code of practice governing bonding patterns (English, Flemish), wetting of bricks prior to laying, joint raking, scaffolding, and curing of brickwork.

allied_standards.title: Specification for Wooden Headforms for Testing of Helmets
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing apparatus standard cited in Clause 6 and Appendix A of IS 2925:1984 for conducting shock absorption (max 5.0 kN transmitted force) and penetration resistance tests.

allied_standards.title: Random Sampling and Randomization Procedures
allied_standards.note: Prescribes statistical random sampling schemes for quality audit and lot acceptance testing of industrial safety helmets under BIS Certification Scheme.

allied_standards.title: Specification for Wooden Headforms for Testing of Helmets
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing apparatus specification cited in Clause 7 and Annex D of IS 4151:2015 for impact attenuation, retention system, and dynamic penetration tests.

allied_standards.title: Electroacoustics — Sound Level Meters: Part 1 Specifications
allied_standards.note: Mandated by Amendment No. 1 (2018) to IS 4151:2015 for conducting hearing attenuation / acoustic audition tests to verify that helmets do not dangerously block traffic sounds.

allied_standards.title: Specification for Visors for Vehicular Helmets
allied_standards.note: Mandatory optical and mechanical specification cited in Clause 5.3 of IS 4151 for helmet visors, governing light transmission, optical distortion, and shatter resistance.

product: Air Circulator Electric Fans and Regulators

allied_standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances: Part 1 General Requirements
allied_standards.note: Mandatory statutory safety baseline for electrical insulation, protection against access to live parts, leakage current, and moisture resistance under Electrical Appliances QCO.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
allied_standards.note: Governing national electrical wiring code specifying mounting heights, earthing connections, sub-circuit loading, and terminal switches for industrial air circulators.

allied_standards.title: Interlocking switch socket outlet, Specification
allied_standards.note: Standard heavy-duty industrial switch-socket outlet specified for safe local power isolation and connection of pedestal/bracket-mounted air circulator fans.

allied_standards.title: Voltage Transformers: Part 1 General Requirements
allied_standards.note: Mandatory parent standard; Clause 1 of IS 3156-3 explicitly dictates that the requirements of Part 1 apply to all protective voltage transformers.

allied_standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances: Part 1 General Requirements
allied_standards.note: Mandatory safety baseline cited in Clause 1 and Clause 5 of IS 368:2014 governing electric shock hazard protection, insulation resistance, and abnormal operation.

allied_standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Household and Similar Purposes of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 V and Rated Current up to and Including 16 A
allied_standards.note: Mandates that immersion heaters be fitted with a non-rewireable 3-pin earthed plug conforming to IS 1293 with permanent earthing pin connection for user safety.

allied_standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances: Part 1 General Requirements
allied_standards.note: Mandatory parent standard; Clause 1 of IS 302-2-3 explicitly dictates that it shall be read in conjunction with IS 302-1.

allied_standards.title: Electric Irons — Specification
allied_standards.note: The primary Indian product performance standard governing heating time, thermostat accuracy, soleplate smoothness, steam output, and endurance for electric irons.

allied_standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Household and Similar Purposes of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 V and Rated Current up to and Including 16 A
allied_standards.note: Mandates that cords of electric irons terminate in an approved 3-pin earthed plug conforming to IS 1293 to ensure earthing continuity.

product: Hexagon Nuts (Product Grades A and B, M1.6 to M64)

allied_standards.title: Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners: Part 6 Mechanical Properties and Test Methods for Nuts with Specified Proof Load Values
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing standard cited in Clause 2 and Table 3 of IS 1364-3 for verifying proof load stress, Vickers/Brinell hardness, and thread stripping strength.

allied_standards.title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grades A and B: Part 1 Hexagon Head Bolts (Size Range M 1.6 to M 64)
allied_standards.note: The matching primary male threaded fastener standard designed to mate with IS 1364-3 hexagon nuts in mechanical engineering and structural assemblies.

allied_standards.title: Fasteners - Single coil rectangular section spring lock washers
allied_standards.note: Anti-loosening spring washer standard routinely specified under bolted joint procurement clauses to prevent nut loosening under cyclic vibration.

allied_standards.title: Metallic Materials — Rockwell Hardness Test: Part 1 Test Method
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing standard cited in Clause 6 of IS 3063:1994 for verifying Rockwell hardness (specified hardness range: 44 to 51 HRC).

allied_standards.title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grades A and B, Part 3: Hexagon Nuts, Style 1 (Size Range M 1.6 to M 64)
allied_standards.note: The principal threaded fastener with which single coil spring lock washers are assembled to prevent vibrational back-off.

allied_standards.title: Drinking Water — Specification
allied_standards.note: The national drinking water standard that sets the legal purity and chemical residue limits (including maximum permissible aluminium of 0.03 mg/l) achieved via IS 260 coagulation.

allied_standards.title: tests on water samples
allied_standards.note: Authoritative analytical test methods used by water treatment plant chemists to measure turbidity, pH, jar-test optimum alum dose, and residual aluminium in treated water.

allied_standards.title: Methods for Determination of Mass Per Unit Length and Mass Per Unit Area of Fabrics
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing standard cited in Clause 2 and Table 1 of IS 3771:2019 for determining fabric mass (grams per square meter - GSM) to verify cloth weight grade.

allied_standards.title: Tensile Properties of Fabrics — Determination of Maximum Force and Elongation at Maximum Force: Part 1 Strip Method
allied_standards.note: Mandatory testing standard cited in Clause 2 and Table 1 of IS 3771:2019 for determining breaking strength (warp and weft direction) of khadi fabric.

allied_standards.title: Methods for Determination of pH Value of Aqueous Extracts of Textile Materials
allied_standards.note: Mandatory chemical test cited in Clause 2 and Clause 5.4 of IS 3771:2019 to verify that residual bleaching chemicals leave fabric pH in the safe skin-neutral range (6.0 to 8.5).
